title: Dead code: unreachable branches and unread symbols

body.signal: Unused variables, functions never called, branches guarded by conditions that cannot occur given the contract.
body.failure_mode: Readers pay maintenance cost for code that never runs; dead guards rot into false confidence about coverage.
body.detection: Vulture scan plus AST reachability analysis over the module; cross-check every flagged symbol against the contract and tests before deleting.
body.fix_strategy: Delete the dead code; keep only symbols the contract or tests reach. Gate: full test suite plus differential equivalence at the public API.

provenance.note: Seeded from hand-authored/analyzed artifacts; promoted by human decision, not agent replay.
